_comment: Dragon bone and dragon scales come only from a slain dragon (Nate, 2026-09-30: 'Dragon bone and scale crafting items can only be picked up from killing a dragon'). The one source is a dragon's own body: the server adds its death item (DeathItemDragon01 and the Dawnguard ones) when it dies (MpActor::AddDeathItem). From 11 Oct (Nate) they are skinned off it, by a Master Skinner only (gamemode.js stashPelts / __dboSkin). Everything else is closed: loot pools and the Ayleid table (dungeons.js, wildlife.js, as for artifacts.json), salvage (salvage.js gives the other materials of dragon gear back, never these), crafting any recipe that makes one (regions.js: Immersive Armors' breakdown recipes), and taking one out of a container the plugins fill with them (gamemode.js take hook: sourceContainers). Staff grants (F7 spawn, console AddItem) stay allowed and are marked DRAGON MATERIAL in the audit log. Only these two items: MGRDragonHeartScales is a College quest item, not a crafting material, and Dragonbone/Dragonscale gear is not covered.
_sourceContainers: Containers whose own record holds dragon materials: QAMiscItemContainer (QA cell), CYRQASmithingContainer (QA cell), and JK's Skyrim XJKdragonB&SstorageChest (a Tamriel exterior, closed while the playtest is held to Bruma).
